该股今日市值已增加 1 万亿美元。

如果英伟达收盘价达到或高于当前水平，它将成为历史上第一家单日市值增加 1 万亿美元的公司。

BREAKING: Nvidia stock, $NVDA, extends gains to over +35% on the day after Jensen Huang is reinstated as CEO.

The stock has now added +$1 trillion in market cap today.

If Nvidia closes at or above current levels, it’ll be the first company in history to add $1 trillion in a day.
